scope: V1 intent retained unchanged; two added requirements quote the authorized material/clamp follow-ups. No physical evidence association.

user_requirements.text: Compact lightweight circular enclosure within the specified envelope.

source.statement: Existing valve approximately 130 mm diameter and 35 mm projection; maximum OD approximately 230 mm; preferred 210–215 mm OD and 80–90 mm projection.

acceptance_criteria: Maximum 50 mm extra radius; approximately 230 mm maximum OD.

user_requirements.text: Preserve the original annular air opening and avoid narrow added passages.

source.statement: Original valve and airflow gap must remain unobstructed; check the entire path, initially aim for 80–100 cm² outlets; effective valve area unknown.

acceptance_criteria: No obstruction of original valve or airflow gap.

user_requirements.text: Removable non-destructive attachment to a stationary rim, preserving valve adjustment.

source.statement: Never grip the disc; mounting surface and rim not measured; keep diameter, clearance and engagement parametric; do not overload attachment.

user_requirements.text: Solid front shield and broad rounded peripheral windows without an extra baffle.

source.statement: Shield direct forward radiation; 6–8 broad rounded windows; smooth internal transitions; no additional internal baffle in V1.

user_requirements.text: PETG FDM manufacture, preferably one support-free part with front against the bed.

source.statement: Shell 2.0–2.4 mm, front 2.4–3.0 mm; avoid unsupported bridges and evaluate taper, window tops, weight and stiffness.

user_requirements.text: Reduce perceived noise while retaining useful airflow, cleanability and stable quiet structure.

source.statement: No guaranteed silencing; no assumption of broadband volume attenuation; avoid whistles, rattles, debris traps and a flexible vibrating front.

user_requirements.text: Further reduce material while preserving diffuser/shield functionality.

source.statement: Do you think it's possible to further reduce the material usage while keeping the functionality? If possible go do it

user_requirements.text: Increase stationary-rim contact and provide compliant adjustable clamping tolerant of modest measurement error.

source.statement: Btw I think you need a bit more contact area with the rim to ensure the mounting is stable, consider also making the mechanism a bit clamping so it's both compliant and clamping so I can mount easily without worrying about slightly wrong measuring
